journey.name: App shortcuts
journey.description: The launcher's shortcuts: Start a workout starts the Timer's workout, Start a Lift session starts one, each over its tab, and a workout already running is kept; a workout started from a shortcut with the app closed comes back from its notification as one app, not two. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval). The app's icon is the one on the home screen or, without one there, in All apps. A shortcut never opens the welcome or "Set up": they wait for the first open from the icon itself, where "Skip to Set up" and "Skip for now" leave them.

actions.action: Long-press the app's icon on the home screen
Verify that the menu offers "Start a workout" and "Start a Lift session"
Verify that the workout screen shows "Get ready" and "Round 1 of 8"
Pull down the shade and tap the workout's notification
Verify that the same workout is shown, and that adb shell dumpsys activity activities lists one MainActivity
Press Home, long-press the app's icon and tap "Start a Lift session"
Verify that the same workout is shown, still counting, and that adb shell dumpsys activity activities lists one MainActivity
Press the system back button and tap "End workout" in the dialog; if a round had finished by then, the summary shows first: tap "Done"
Verify that the Timer is shown with a "Start workout" button
Press Home, long-press the app's icon and tap "Start a Lift session"
Verify that the session shows "Log set"
Press the system back button and tap "Leave" in the dialog
Verify that Train's Strength pillar is shown with "Start session"
